name: Give Gerard a Drink
summary: Give Gerard a Drink is a straightforward favor for Gerard Tiller, a farmer toiling at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Looking to quench his thirst under the sun, he trades basic produce in exchange for bottles of fresh spring water. It offers young adventurers an early lesson in barter and supporting local laborers.

sections.title: Thirsty Work in the Vineyard Fields
sections.body: The farms of Elwynn Forest produce much of the grain, fruit, and vegetables consumed by Stormwind's townsfolk and garrisons. Tending the rows of crops under the open sky is grueling, hot work. Gerard Tiller spends long days out in the dirt at the Maclure Vineyards, keeping the pests away and managing the harvests. With little time to run back and forth to town wells, he relies on passing recruits to bring him clean spring water to keep going.

sections.title: The Economy of Barter
sections.body: Rather than dealing in coin, Gerard prefers a fair and simple exchange of provisions. Travelers carrying extra flasks of Refreshing Spring Water can trade them directly for fresh apples picked from the orchard. In a kingdom stretching its resources thin to maintain order and feed its army, direct bartering among smallholders and recruits remains a practical way of getting by in rural Elwynn.

faq.answer: Gerard Tiller is a humble farmer working the agricultural plots at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest. He manages the fields and orchards that supply the local residents.
Laboring in the fields all day under the sun is exhausting work. Gerard relies on passing travelers to supply him with fresh spring water so he can stay hydrated without abandoning his chores.

faq.q: Where can Refreshing Spring Water be found?
faq.answer: Refreshing Spring Water is commonly sold by food and drink vendors or innkeepers throughout Elwynn Forest, including Brother Danil inside Northshire Abbey.
Yes. Gerard is continually working the fields and remains eager to trade fresh orchard apples for additional bottles of water as long as you have them to spare.

faq.q: What does Gerard offer in return for the drink?
faq.answer: In exchange for fresh water, Gerard trades a Shiny Red Apple.
He can be found outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: Supporting Northshire's farmers ensures that the Abbey's garrison and priests remain well-fed during a turbulent period of kingdom defense.
For humans starting their journeys in Northshire, aiding neighbors like Gerard Tiller is an early example of the communal spirit that holds Elwynn together.
